discriminating_logic: Development of infantile spasms and early-onset feeding difficulties strongly separates RAMELN from non-syndromic primary microcephalies, which do not typically exhibit epileptic encephalopathy or infantile spasms.

overlapping_phenotypes: severe microcephaly, profound intellectual disability, early-onset seizures, severe feeding difficulties
discriminating_logic: There are no reliable positive clinical discriminators at the bedside; pure phenotypic separation is impossible and requires molecular genetic testing (WES/WGS).
Absence of ocular coloboma, microphthalmia, and major conotruncal heart defects in RAMELN rules out CHARGE syndrome.
